question: Should acpx reserve `zeroclaw` as a built-in agent name that resolves to `zeroclaw acp`, or should ZeroClaw remain a custom command/config override for now?
rationale: The diff is small, but built-in names are stable product surface and this changes fallback command resolution for the `zeroclaw` token; automation cannot decide whether this vendor-specific alias belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor ZeroClaw as a built-in
options.body: Keep this PR open, require live acpx-plus-ZeroClaw proof and release-note cleanup, then land the alias if maintainers accept the name reservation.

options.title: Keep ZeroClaw custom-only
options.body: Close or redirect the work to docs/custom agent configuration if maintainers do not want another core built-in alias.

options.title: Defer built-in intake policy
options.body: Hold this alongside https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/436 until maintainers decide criteria for adding new native ACP agents to the registry.

recommendation.title: Sponsor ZeroClaw as a built-in
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require live acpx-plus-ZeroClaw proof and release-note cleanup, then land the alias if maintainers accept the name reservation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on adding and releasing built-in agent registry changes with proof requirements.
